artifact.what_sw: Faida POS ni app na mfumo (system): POS ya Flutter yenye risiti za thermal, tahadhari za stoo, matawi mengi, na APK kupitia GitHub Releases
artifact.what_en: Faida POS is an app and a system: Flutter POS with thermal receipts, low-stock alerts, multi-branch tracking and APK builds from GitHub Releases
numbers: Care Plan TSh 99,000/mwezi (huduma tofauti, si SaaS)

hook.sw: Nazima Wi-Fi kwenye duka. Mauzo hayasimami.
hook.en: I turn off the Wi-Fi in the shop. The sale still goes through.

scenes.claim_sw: Faida POS ni app na system: inarekodi mauzo, inatoa risiti, na inasasisha stoo hata bila internet, kisha inasync muunganisho ukirudi.
scenes.claim_en: Faida POS is an app and a system: it records the sale, prints the receipt and updates stock with no connection, then syncs when the network returns.

beats.visual: Frame 1: real hand flipping a phone's Wi-Fi toggle; navy frame, gold crosshair, coords in mono
Cut to POS terminal on a real screen, barcode scan, receipt line appearing
Real code window, 4 lines, line numbers, gold strings. Code is rendered, never generated by a video model
beats.text_en: lang: sw lives in the code.

beats.visual: Thermal receipt sliding up, DEMO label, M-PESA row, then a gold SYNCED pill on the phone
Paper section, big Fraunces line, one gold hand-drawn underline, keyword in mono
beats.text_sw: Hii ndiyo tofauti kati ya demo na mfumo wa dukani.
beats.text_en: That is the difference between a demo and a shop system.

scenes.payoff_sw: Kama unahitaji app hii leo, comment neno POS.
scenes.payoff_en: If you need this app today, comment the word POS.

final_card.logo_note: Real logo supplied by the owner (final_poster_1.png), transparent PNG. Never redrawn by an AI model.
credits: Tunatengeneza app na mifumo ya biashara
Built in Tanzania, for how Tanzania really works.
final_card.visual: Paper end card: real logo, Altraware credits, one keyword CTA card. Every glyph is Pillow text; no AI-drawn logo, code or numbers
final_card.text_sw: Kama unahitaji app hii leo, comment neno POS.
final_card.text_en: If you need this app today, comment the word POS.
final_card.cta_sw: UNAHITAJI KUIONA LEO? COMMENT NENO POS
final_card.cta_en: NEED TO SEE IT TODAY? COMMENT THE WORD POS
final_card.motion: logo reveals 0.6s, credits one per 0.3s, CTA pops 0.3s

scenes.audio: No music under the first 2 seconds. One UI click on the Wi-Fi toggle, one thermal printer click under the receipt, low room tone. Kiswahili TTS: 6 clips (5 beats + credits/CTA) in audio/*.wav assembled by render_reel_final.py; the owner adds music in the editor. Burn in captions.
scenes.guard: Usiseme '100%' wala '100% offline' wala '0.8s checkout' wala '10x faster'. Sema offline-first, cloud-synced. Tagline: Built in Tanzania, for how Tanzania really works. Bei zote ni za kuanzia; Care Plan 99k/mwezi ni huduma tofauti, si SaaS. Angalia 09-decisions.md.
